newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Electricidad de Caracas revives investment plans.
newsitem.headline: Electricidad de Caracas revives investment plans.

text.p: Leading Venezuelan utility Electricidad de Caracas is to re-start its suspended investment program after it was awarded large rate increases late last month, the company said.

The company's 68.7 billion bolivar ($140 million) program will be used to maintain and expand the electricity transmission network and generating capacity, Electricidad said in a press release. Last year, the company's investment program totaled 31 billion bolivars.
Electricidad, the bellwether issue of the Caracas stock exchange, was awarded a long-awaited 75 percent rate increase on June 25, with the hike to be phased in over six months.
